title: Burkhard Heim and Martin's RIAS anti-gravity outfit

tellings.quote: you know, stuff and then he was brought over to the US and I think he worked with Lockheed Martin or Martin Corporation pre-Lockheed merger.

plain: A scientist named Burkhard Heim was brought over to the US and, Michels thinks, worked with the Martin Corporation before it merged with Lockheed, in a Martin research unit called RIAS that the story describes as an anti-gravity outfit. Michels tells this himself, hedged with "I think" and without naming a source. If true, it would mean an American aircraft company was hiring foreign scientists to work on anti-gravity.
